profile_note: FASTEST125 and GENERIC57600 admit <=128-byte payloads plus exactly 256-byte READ ($52), PUT without verification ($50) and explicitly verified WRITE ($57); other larger payloads remain unsupported. Filesystem writes use PUT ($50). GENERIC57600 uses POKEY divisor 8 in command and data phases, matching Altirra Generic + 57600 baud (generic56k); this is a nominal rate, not exact 57600 baud on PAL. STOCK810 retains <=128 payload bytes; Happy1050 NONE only. Default/max active timeout is 1,000,000 us for FASTEST125/HAPPY1050 and 2,000,000 us for STOCK810/GENERIC57600, including mechanical spin-up, seek and rotation. Zero selects that profile default; explicit shorter timeouts are honored, minimum 4,041 us. Unsafe recovery requires platform reset; no retry or baud fallback. STANDARD19200 uses divisor 40, raw payloads 1..512 and a 15,000,000 us default/max active timeout. It supports all admitted units, including control $70. It does not interpret peripheral command bytes. Legacy profile admission is unchanged. SIO_OPEN_EXCLUSIVE requires no existing unit opens and excludes new shared/exclusive opens until close.
